name: pmkisan_authenticate_farmer
description: Validates farmer credentials and generates an active authentication session. Requires the farmer to have a valid Aadhaar and mobile number registered in the system. Aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits, mobile must be 10 digits, and OTP must be 6 digits. Returns a session_token valid for subsequent secure operations. Does not perform registration or Aadhaar enrolment. Fails if the OTP is incorrect, expired, or if the Aadhaar is blocked.

name: pmkisan_check_eligibility
description: Checks if a farmer meets the basic criteria for the PM-KISAN scheme based on state records. Requires an existing Aadhaar record in the demographic database. Aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits. Returns the eligibility_status which can be unknown, eligible, ineligible, or rejected. Does not verify active bank accounts or perform eKYC. Fails if the Aadhaar number is syntactically invalid or not found in the state registry.

name: pmkisan_validate_land_records
description: Queries state land registry databases to confirm land ownership details for scheme inclusion. Requires the state land database to be online and accessible. State code must be a 2-digit integer, district code a 3-digit integer, and plot number alphanumeric. Returns a boolean indicating land ownership verification success. Does not mutate the PM-KISAN beneficiary database directly or disburse funds. Fails if the land record is not found, under dispute, or belongs to an institutional landholder.

name: pmkisan_register_farmer
description: Enrolls a new farmer into the PM-KISAN scheme and creates a beneficiary record. Requires an active authentication session, confirmed eligibility, and validated land records. Aadhaar must be 12 digits, IFSC must be 11 characters, and state/district codes must be valid integers. Returns a unique beneficiary_id and updates registration_status to registered. Does not process immediate installment payments or complete eKYC. Fails if the farmer is already registered (duplicate registration attempt), if eligibility is not eligible, or if the session is invalid.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private beneficiary data [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmkisan_complete_ekyc
description: Completes mandatory eKYC verification using Aadhaar OTP to unlock installment disbursements. Requires an active authentication session and a registered beneficiary with ekyc_status: pending. Beneficiary ID must be alphanumeric and OTP must be 6 digits. Returns the updated ekyc_status as completed. Does not handle biometric updates or Aadhaar demographic changes. Fails if eKYC is already completed, if the OTP is invalid, or if the beneficiary is excluded from the scheme.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private beneficiary data [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmkisan_get_beneficiary_status
description: Retrieves the current registration, eKYC, and eligibility status of a PM-KISAN applicant. Requires the farmer to have initiated registration in the past. Aadhaar must be 12 digits and mobile must be 10 digits. Returns the registration_status, ekyc_status, and eligibility_status. Does not return detailed financial transaction histories or bank account numbers. Fails if neither Aadhaar nor mobile number match any existing records.

name: pmkisan_get_payment_history
description: Fetches the complete ledger of past PM-KISAN installments credited or failed for a specific beneficiary. Requires an active authentication session and a beneficiary with registration_status: verified. Beneficiary ID must be a valid alphanumeric identifier. Returns a list of past transactions with dates, amounts, and payment_status. Does not initiate new payments or retry failed transactions. Fails if the session is invalid, the beneficiary ID does not exist, or the farmer is not yet verified.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private beneficiary data [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmkisan_track_installment_status
description: Checks the real-time processing state of a specific upcoming or recent PM-KISAN installment. Requires the beneficiary to be registered and the installment cycle to be currently active. Installment number must be one of installment_1, installment_2, or installment_3. Returns the installment_status (due, processed, credited, or failed) and the expected processing date. Does not update bank details or resolve pending holds. Fails if the beneficiary ID is invalid or if querying an installment cycle that has not yet begun.

installment_number.description: The specific installment cycle to track [EXACT]

name: pmkisan_track_payment
description: Queries the national payment gateway to verify the clearing status of a specific PM-KISAN fund transfer. Requires a valid transaction ID generated from a processed installment. Transaction ID must be a 16-character alphanumeric string. Returns the exact payment_status (pending, credited, or failed) and bank clearing timestamps. Does not display the farmer's full bank account number or Aadhaar details. Fails if the transaction ID is malformed or not found in the payment gateway logs.

name: pmkisan_update_bank_details
description: Updates the bank account information linked to a beneficiary profile for future installment routing. Requires an active authentication session and a verified beneficiary record. IFSC code must be exactly 11 characters and account number must be numeric. Returns a success confirmation and the updated bank mandate timestamp. Does not redirect funds for already processed installments or guarantee immediate NPCI mapping. Fails if the new account fails NPCI validation, if the IFSC is inactive, or if the session is expired.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private beneficiary data [TYPE_ONLY]

new_account_number.description: New bank account number for DBT [EXACT]

name: pmkisan_resolve_payment_failure
description: Triggers a re-processing request for a stalled or bounced installment transfer. Requires an active authentication session and an installment that currently has payment_status: failed. Transaction ID must be a 16-character alphanumeric string. Returns a new retry transaction ID and sets the installment_status to processed. Does not instantly credit funds to the bank account. Fails if the original transaction is not in a failed state, if bank details have not been corrected, or if the session is invalid.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private beneficiary data [TYPE_ONLY]

resolution_action.description: Description of corrective action taken before retry [SUBSTRING]

name: pmkisan_get_exclusion_reason
description: Retrieves the specific regulatory reason why a farmer was deemed ineligible or removed from the scheme. Requires the farmer to have an eligibility_status of ineligible or rejected. Aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits. Returns the specific exclusion_reason enum value. Does not allow submitting appeals or uploading tax clearance certificates. Fails if the farmer is currently eligible, if the Aadhaar is not found, or if the format is invalid.

name: pmkisan_raise_grievance
description: Submits a formal complaint regarding PM-KISAN issues such as delayed payments or eKYC failures. Requires an active authentication session and a beneficiary record that has already been verified. Category must be a valid grievance_category enum and description must be between 10 and 500 characters. Returns a unique grievance_id for future tracking. Does not guarantee immediate financial resolution or override exclusion rules. Fails if a grievance for the same category is already pending, if the description is too short, or if the session token is missing.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private beneficiary data [TYPE_ONLY]

description.description: Detailed explanation of the issue being faced [SUBSTRING]

name: pmkisan_track_grievance_status
description: Retrieves the current resolution status and official remarks for a previously submitted complaint. Requires a valid grievance ID generated during submission. Grievance ID must be a 10-character alphanumeric string. Returns the current status (open, in_progress, resolved) and an official resolution remark. Does not allow adding new comments or reopening closed grievances. Fails if the grievance ID does not exist or is formatted incorrectly.

grievance_id.description: Unique identifier of the submitted grievance [TYPE_ONLY]

name: pmkisan_verify_bank_account
description: Checks if a specified bank account is active and capable of receiving direct benefit transfers (DBT) via NPCI. Requires the bank account to be registered with a participating DBT bank. IFSC must be 11 characters and account number must be numeric. Returns a boolean indicating if the account is DBT-active. Does not link the account to any specific PM-KISAN beneficiary or fetch account balances. Fails if the IFSC is invalid or if the bank is not part of the NPCI network.

account_number.description: Bank account number to be verified [EXACT]

name: pmkisan_resend_otp
description: Generates and sends a new one-time password to the farmer's registered mobile number for authentication. Requires the farmer to have a valid Aadhaar and mobile number mapped in the system. Aadhaar must be 12 digits and mobile must be 10 digits. Returns a success confirmation indicating the OTP dispatch. Does not complete the authentication process or generate a session token itself. Fails if the mobile number does not match the Aadhaar record or if the daily OTP limit has been exceeded.
